size-xs.$description: 12 px: icons inside captions and badges.

size-sm.$description: 14 px: the most common Figma icon size (resource chips, info icons, KPI chips).

size-md.$description: 16 px: buttons, inputs, table actions. The default.

size-lg.$description: 20 px: navigation items and the KPI bar.

stroke-thin.$description: The Figma stroke: 1 px at 16 to 20 px. Icons are drawn with an absolute stroke, so it stays 1 px at every size.

stroke-regular.$description: For small icons that must stay legible on low-density screens and projectors.

stroke-bold.$description: Emphasis, and icons on solid buttons.

width.$description: Keyboard focus outline (the colour is color.focus-ring).
